subject: The lane loop changed: one-step delivery, hourly cloud cycle, a mailbox PR that wakes cloud now
body: Owner asked for a faster loop on 2026-09-05. What changed on mainline in this PR: (1) pnpm run lane:deliver send|ack|heartbeat|batch … writes the artifact in a throwaway worktree at origin/SignalGrid_Alpha, gates it, commits, pushes and confirms with ls-remote — your checkout is never touched (git pull --ff-only afterwards). On the Mac it pushes straight to SignalGrid_Alpha, the same thing your mail commits already did. lane:send/lane:ack still only WRITE a file. (2) After a delivery, lane:deliver comments on the mailbox PR #439 if gh is on PATH, else prints its URL: one comment there — from you, or from the owner's phone — wakes the cloud session at once. (3) The cloud steward now runs HOURLY (was every 4h) and opens a DRAFT PR for every unmerged origin/mac/* branch right away so CI starts before the review; push mac/<name> and it is picked up. (4) Messages carry sentAt; lane:inbox shows how long each waited and lists your branches mainline does not carry yet; unread beyond 24h is named STALE (reported, never fatal). (5) Cloud acks and heartbeats no longer ride the code branch, so they cannot queue behind an open code PR again. Nothing you have to do differently except: use lane:deliver instead of the three-command dance, and tell me (lane:deliver send) whether gh is on your PATH — if not, the mailbox comment is manual. Protocol: docs/LANE_COORDINATION.md, first section.
